closed_findings: Actual corpus evidence is verified before pilot acceptance and rechecked after execution.
The actual manifest, locations, evidence and review files have before/after anchors.
Required answer and proof negatives include complete contextual source export mutations.
The report itself is included in the final artifact limit via a bounded fixed-point write.
The accepted resolver rules are reconstructed independently from pinned source imports and reviewed root mounts.
The complete accepted configuration identity table is reconstructed from pinned original Git blobs.
Scoped Git enumeration preserves existing startswith semantics for directory and partial basename prefixes, with literal pathspecs and a final complete scope filter.
Every checked artifact directory is inventoried after its existing complete content checks and rehashed immediately before whole-stage acceptance.
Missing files, added files and same-size content substitutions invalidate the inventory and block acceptance.

Receipts cover graph variants, source fixture Git and index data, source bridge, graph proofs, formal ladder, real pilot selection/report/query proofs, indexing, process enforcement tests and full regression process evidence.
The regression memory override is an explicit positive CLI value, defaults to 4 GiB, and changes only the separate regression configuration. Other Lean and benchmark limits retain 4 GiB.
The planned new regression experiment uses 6442450944 bytes and records its actual configured limit in the report and supervisor receipt.

Historical report contents are compared with the original Git blob after CRLF-to-LF normalization on both byte strings. Exact original Git blob IDs and exact raw checkout SHA-256 values are retained, and raw checkout bytes must remain identical before and after the run.
The historical CRLF fixture remains byte-identical during inventory collection and substantive content mutation is rejected.

New LF-only manifest04 preserves the exact parsed source universe and mapping. Evidence04 changes only its manifest byte anchor. Earlier CRLF manifest and evidence remain preserved, and the LF anchor survives Git text checkout normalization.
The history check supports a legacy CRLF Git blob followed by later LF attributes, rejects substantive mutations, and performs no report writes.

The mandatory negative-test log matcher compares the exact method name and fully qualified test ID against complete splitlines records. It accepts LF, CRLF and CR and rejects wrong modules, failures, skips and trailing text. Each accepted category records its exact test ID.
independent_review.pending: Final06 reruns all dependent controls with this exact code inventory, LF manifest04/evidence04 and explicit 6 GiB regression-only experiment. Final05 and earlier results remain preserved.

Complete artifact inventories after semantic checks, final filesystem identity verification, pilot proof receipts and whole-stage artifact acceptance gate
